name: coffee companion
tagline: Works out how to brew each new bag and keeps the log in Notion
description: Before you open a fresh bag it goes looking for what the roaster says about those beans, then hands you a card with grind, dose, water and timing to start from. Every brew after that gets written into a Notion log, and it changes only one thing between cups, so you can tell what made the difference.
author: andymadrick
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
